# Error summary

The errors of a refused form, as links to their fields, focused on submit.

- Status: implemented
- Category: feedback
- Pattern: HTML `<div role="alert" tabindex="-1"> with a list of links`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **title**: How many problems.
- **list**: Each error links to its field.

## Variants

- `default`:

## States

- `default`
- `focus-visible`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Through the error links. |
| Enter | Moves focus to the field. |

## Accessibility

- Role: alert
- Name: Its title.
- Receives focus when the form is refused.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 2.4.3 Focus Order (A)
- 3.3.1 Error Identification (A)
- 3.3.3 Error Suggestion (AA)
- 4.1.3 Status Messages (AA)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-error-summary" role="alert" tabindex="-1">
  <p class="nd-error-summary__title">Two fields need attention</p>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="#ex-email">Enter an email address</a></li>
    <li><a href="#ex-name">Enter your name</a></li>
  </ul>
</div>
```
